name: Dōshi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Dōshi village emblem in navy: a stylised device of a ring with a pointed top and winged strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Dōshi, a village in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 March 1966.

features.role: Dōshi village emblem — a stylised device of a ring with a pointed top and winged strokes
